title: FeedGenie-Prime

sections.heading: FeedGenie-Prime
sections.text: Mycotoxin contamination—especially from aflatoxins, ochratoxins, zearalenone, and deoxynivalenol—poses a silent yet severe threat to poultry productivity. These toxins undermine immune function, reduce weight gain and negatively impact overall flock performance. FeedGenie-Prime is a holistic mycotoxin management system that combines super-activated bio-composite clay with multi-ligand bioactive copper. Its comprehensive adsorption mechanism not only detoxifies a wide array of challenging mycotoxins but also supports the animal’s natural immunity. In addition to effective binding of a wide range of mycotoxins, the product also supports the animal’s immune function. Components Multi-ligand bioactive copper Bio-absorbable spices with Lactobacillus culture metabolites Super activated bio-composite clay
